strings.error:alreadyregistered: This security key secret has already been registered.
strings.info: Use a physical security key or fingerprint scanner.
strings.logindesc: Click continue to use your security key.
strings.loginskip: I don't have my security key
strings.logintitle: Verify it's you by security key
strings.privacy:metadata: The Security key factor plugin does not store any personal data.
strings.settings:description:
Users authenticate using a physical security key, such as a USB or NFC token, or a biometric method like a fingerprint. During login, they must physically use their security key to verify their identity.

Users will need to set up their own security keys first.
strings.settings:shortdescription: Require users to use a security key, like a USB or NFC token, or a biometric method, during login.
strings.settings:userverification_help: Serves to ensure the person authenticating is in fact who they say they are. User verification can take various forms, such as password, PIN, fingerprint, etc.
strings.setupfactor:intro: A security key is a physical device that you can use to authenticate yourself. Security keys can be USB tokens, Bluetooth devices, or event built-in fingerprint scanners on your phone or computer.
strings.setupfactor:securitykeyinfo: This helps you identify which security key you are using.
strings.userverification:discouraged: User verification should not be employed, for example to minimize user interaction
strings.userverification:preferred: User verification is preferred, authentication will not fail if user verification is missing
strings.userverification:required: User verification is required (e.g. by pin). Authentication fails if key does not have user verification
